fields.label: Actionable feedback
fields.operation_and_denominator: `N(respondents able to name a specific, feasible next practice step tied to their cited answer) / N(report recipients answering the fixed actionability item)`; report survey response rate. Optional later follow-up records tried/not tried among those who permitted contact.
fields.source_phase_and_interpretation: Blinded coding of short responses and follow-up; P2/E08. Satisfaction alone is insufficient; self-reported practice is not skill improvement.
